parts.name: Chest Lid
parts.Basic_description: The chest lid is the top cover of the storage chest, made of wood and rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the cover to protect and enclose the contents of the chest, and can be opened or closed via hinges.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around the hinge axis to open and downward to close.

parts.name: Chest Box
parts.Basic_description: The chest box is the main body of the storage chest, made of wood and forming the container space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage volume for items placed inside the chest.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the lid and base.

parts.name: Chest Base
parts.Basic_description: The chest base is the bottom structural part of the chest, made of wood and supporting the entire object.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the chest, ensuring it stands evenly on the ground.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Handle (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A brass handle attached to the left side of the chest for lifting or carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to lift or move the chest conveniently.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot slightly outward when pulled and return to rest when released.

parts.name: Handle (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A brass handle attached to the right side of the chest for lifting or carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip point for lifting or moving the chest.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot slightly outward when pulled and return to rest when released.

parts.name: Bolt (Front)
parts.Basic_description: A steel bolt located at the front of the chest, securing the lid and box together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides fastening strength to hold the lid and box in alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Bolt (Side)
parts.Basic_description: A steel bolt located on the side of the chest, used for structural reinforcement.
parts.Functional_description: It strengthens the connection between the side panels and the base.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Bolt (Rear)
parts.Basic_description: A steel bolt located at the rear of the chest, securing the hinge area.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the hinge assembly in place, ensuring smooth lid movement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports hinge rotation.
